$comment: Example permanent port reservations (Phase 12 M2.1). Copy to config/ports.json — or just use `ai-orchestrator ports reserve <project> <port> --service <name>`, which writes this file for you. A reservation means: something OUTSIDE this machine expects to find a service at this address, so it must not move. Everything else should be left to automatic allocation, which derives a stable port from the project and service name and confirms it is free by binding it. Dynamic allocations live in state/ports.json and are machine-owned — never put them here. See CONFIGURATION.md 'Port registry'.

reservations.note: stable endpoint expected by external callers
